# Asset credits

All files are free-licensed, except the generated models below, which the project owner made and owns. Downloaded files were handled as untrusted data (binary only). Total size about 29 MB.

## Generated by the project owner (AssetHub, Tripo 3.1), owned by the project owner
Generated with AssetHub (Tripo 3.1 mesh, Tripo v2.5 auto-rig for the people), paid for and owned by the project owner. Shrunk with gltf-transform (textures resized and re-encoded to WebP; the palm welded and simplified to about 7.5k triangles).
- models/character/male.glb - the player: a man in a teal floral shirt and jeans. Rigged (52 bones, A-pose, no clips); the game retargets the mannequin's clips onto it. 1024 px textures.
- models/character/female.glb - a woman in a white tank top and denim shorts, for pedestrians. Rigged without neck or head bones. 1024 px textures.
- models/vehicle/sports_car.glb - an orange wedge sports car body without wheels (the game adds its own). 2048 px textures.
- models/vehicle/police.glb - a black and white police sedan body without wheels, with a roof light bar. 2048 px textures.
- models/vegetation/palm.glb - a coconut palm with solid fronds. 1024 px textures.

## Character
- models/character/mannequin_ual.glb (3.0 MB) - Quaternius, Universal Animation Library (Standard, free) - https://quaternius.com/packs/universalanimationlibrary.html (gltf obtained from https://github.com/J-Ponzo/gltf-universal-animation-library, repacked to glb with gltf-transform) - CC0 1.0
  - One skinned mesh named "Mannequin" (neutral mannequin, not photoreal), Rigify-style DEF-* bones, 1 skin, 46 clips:
  - A_TPose, Crouch_Fwd_Loop, Crouch_Idle_Loop, Dance_Loop, Death01, Driving_Loop, Fixing_Kneeling, Hit_Chest, Hit_Head, Idle_Loop, Idle_Talking_Loop, Idle_Torch_Loop, Interact, Jog_Fwd_Loop, Jump_Land, Jump_Loop, Jump_Start, PickUp_Table, Pistol_Aim_Down, Pistol_Aim_Neutral, Pistol_Aim_Up, Pistol_Idle_Loop, Pistol_Reload, Pistol_Shoot, Punch_Cross, Punch_Enter, Punch_Jab, Push_Loop, Roll, Roll_RM, Sitting_Enter, Sitting_Exit, Sitting_Idle_Loop, Sitting_Talking_Loop, Spell_Simple_Enter, Spell_Simple_Exit, Spell_Simple_Idle_Loop, Spell_Simple_Shoot, Sprint_Loop, Swim_Fwd_Loop, Swim_Idle_Loop, Sword_Attack, Sword_Attack_RM, Sword_Idle, Walk_Formal_Loop, Walk_Loop
  - Covers idle, walk, jog, sprint, jump (start/loop/land), swim, pistol aim/shoot/reload, driving (seated pose).

## Vegetation
- models/vegetation/ph_fern_02.glb (1.1 MB) - Poly Haven "Fern 02", Rob Tuytel (scan), Rico Cilliers (model), https://polyhaven.com/a/fern_02 - CC0. Nodes fern_02_a..d. 1k textures embedded (repacked from gltf with gltf-transform).

## Props
- models/props/TrafficLight.glb, Sign_Stop.glb - Quaternius, Ultimate Modular Streets / street pack - https://quaternius.com (glb copies from https://github.com/trebeljahr/quaternius-showcase) - CC0 1.0. Single root mesh named after the file.
